ROAD TRANSPORT ACT 1987

ROAD TRANSPORT (PROHIBITION OF USE OF ROAD)

(CITY OF KUALA LUMPUR) ORDER 2020

WHEREAS by P.U. (B) 101/2020 published on 6 February 2020, notice was given of the

intention to make an order under section 70 of the Road Transport Act 1987 [Act 333];

AND WHEREAS no objection was received by the Commissioner of the City of

Kuala Lumpur against the making of such order;

NOW THEREFORE, in exercise of the powers conferred by section 70 of the Act,

the Commissioner of the City of Kuala Lumpur, after consultation with the

Director General for Road Transport and after taking into consideration the matters

referred to in subsection 70(2) of the Act, makes the following order:

Citation

1. (1) This order may be cited as the Road Transport (Prohibition of Use of

Road) (City of Kuala Lumpur) Order 2020.

Prohibition

2. The driving of vehicles on the part of the road specified in column (1) of the

First Schedule as shown on the map in the Second Schedule, otherwise than on the

routes specified in column (2) of the First Schedule, with effect from the date specified

in column (3) of the First Schedule, is prohibited.
